Update the documented timeout so users know how long requests can wait when they omit `--timeout`.

## Changes

The pull request raises the default request timeout from 30 to 60 seconds and updates the parser test to expect 60. Explicit `--timeout` values still override the default. The pull request also adds `review.txt`.
